subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Land Rover engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ300P across its Land Rover applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ300P is the petrol six-cylinder option across the Land Rover range — five model lines spanning Defender, Discovery, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport and Range Rover Velar.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with MHEV/PHEV ancillaries additionally accounted for on hybrid applications.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the AJ300P across any of its five applications — it's considered generally reliable. That's a genuinely different situation from several other engines in our network where a specific wear pattern is well-documented — for the AJ300P, we don't have one to report, and we won't invent one to sound more thorough.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ300P rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: LAND ROVER AJ300P REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ300P is part of the Ingenium family and follows the same rebuild pattern as other Ingenium six-cylinder engines. The twin-scroll turbocharger, timing chain system and gasket set are all replaced as standard. On MHEV applications, the 48V mild-hybrid components are inspected and accounted for during the rebuild. On PHEV applications, the full hybrid-system ancillary set is handled alongside the combustion engine work. Full engine replacements require DME software matching.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain, bearings, gaskets, twin-scroll turbocharger inspection, plus hybrid-system ancillaries on MHEV/PHEV applications
